PRIDE:0001013 study sample; PRIDE:0000899 reference (child of PRIDE:0000898 multiplex sample under PRIDE:0000895). Heavy = internal reference per ref45 ("served as an internal reference").
Sample list "Tissue type" = Lung for all 49 (light). Heavy: all three reference lines are lung-derived (Cellosaurus tissue Lung). UBERON:0002048.

Sample list "Hitology" = adenocarcinoma (ADC) for every sample (4 x "ADC, mucinous"); paper "For 49 LUAD tumors". MONDO:0005061. Heavy rows not applicable: mix of LUAD, LUSC and large-cell lines (precedent PXD000690/PXD001963).

claims.evidence: Each light source is one tumour of one case (49 distinct PHLC individuals), measured once. Reference mixes three cell lines from different donors (HCC827 female 39Y; NCI-H520 male; NCI-H460 male).

One full MS scan (400-1,200 m/z).

limitations: No MaxQuant mqpar.xml/parameters.txt/summary.txt deposited for the UHN arm (only proteinGroups.txt). Oxidation (M) and the H/L multiplicity are read from proteinGroups; the Lys8/Arg10 masses come from ref. 45 (same lab, same standard, same 2015 Orbitrap Elite method), not from this search. Carbamidomethyl (C) Fixed is inferred (IAA alkylation + PRIDE PTM list + MaxQuant default). Acetyl (Protein N-term), a MaxQuant default, is NOT annotated because nothing deposited evidences it for this search (protein N-term mods never yield proteinGroups site columns).

Precursor/fragment mass tolerances of the MaxQuant 2.4.7.0 search are not stated ("parameters we outlined previously" -> ref45 lists none) -> not available; this makes parse_sdrf convert-openms fail (converter cannot read reserved words; campaign precedent PXD006676/PXD009868 kept the honest reserved word).

The study comparison for this arm, primary LUAD that did vs did not develop brain metastasis within 5 years (paper Results s142, Ext. Data Fig. 6b), CANNOT be annotated per sample. Sources checked: the deposited UHN_Lung_Tissue_IMPACT_SampleList.xlsx (label, ID, Project, Tissue type, Histology only); the paper full text (PMC11750707: cohort-level counts only) and its only ESM (MOESM1 reporting summary, image-only PDF, no supplementary tables); the Nature article page (no other ESM / source data); GEO GSE220838 sample records (196 GSM, characteristics only "disease state: Lung adenocarcinoma", titles GZLBM2022tissueNNN, no link to PHLC labels); GitHub patilvikas/BrainMetsPrediction (R code only, no clinical data); ref45 PMC9808373 (no per-patient outcome linked to PHLC labels). Per rule 18 no outcome is inferred; factor value[disease] is a constant placeholder (lung adenocarcinoma / not applicable) and carries no comparison. Age, sex, ancestry, stage and EGFR status are likewise unavailable per sample.
characteristics[individual] = PHLC case prefix; the deposit does not define "PHLC" or say the ID column is a patient (vs specimen) identifier.
Raw files are deposited only inside a 7z archive; comment[data file] gives member names.
PRIDE instruments (Orbitrap Fusion Lumos, Bruker) and quantification methods (SILAC, diaPASEF) are project-wide; per-arm values come from raw headers.
techsdrf not installed; raw verification = UTF-16 header strings of all 49 .raw members (instrument, method, folder date).
